area: Multiple branches (Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Mall, Dubai Festival City, Arabian Ranches, Mirdif City Centre)

avoid_dishes.reason: Check that they are not thickened with a roux.

name: Café Bateel
questions: Does any GF pasta contain quinoa? Which brand is it?
Do any of the GF breads contain oat flour or oats?
Is the bisque or cream sauce thickened with flour?
Is the GF menu still offered at this branch?
quinoa_oat_flags: 'Three cheese quinoa rigatoni' made with GF pasta appeared on the GF menu (Time Out Abu Dhabi). This is QUINOA, so avoid it.
The GF menu includes 'superfood salads', which likely contain quinoa. Check.
Ask whether any of the GF breads contain oat flour.

safe_dishes.dish: Dishes from the separate gluten-free menu (pastas, soups)
safe_dishes.note: Bayut and What's On describe a 100% gluten-free menu. The pasta brand is unknown.

safe_dishes.dish: Tiger prawn spaghetti in cherry tomato and crab bisque (GF menu)
safe_dishes.note: From a Harper's Bazaar Arabia write-up of the GF menu launch, which is older. Ask whether the bisque is flour-thickened.
An Atly reviewer at Dubai Hills got three kinds of GF bread.

summary: Café Bateel publicly launched a separate gluten-free menu, covered in several older articles, and a recent-looking Atly review at Dubai Hills confirms GF breads, but at least one GF pasta has used quinoa.
